| `JsoncFingerprint` | Class | Static entry points for canonical JSON serialization (RFC 8785, the JSON Canonicalization Scheme) and SHA-256 content fingerprints. Not instantiable. | canonical json serialization rfc 8785, sha-256 content hash, deduplicate or diff json documents |
